claims.statement: With OAuth App restrictions enabled, members and outside collaborators cannot independently authorize organization-resource access. They may request owner approval and owners receive pending-request notifications. A request or notification is not approval, effective access or installation authority; enabled restriction state requires actual readback.

The fragment permits response format negotiation through Accept, giving JSON and XML examples. Parent endpoint and supported response schemas remain unspecified here; selecting a format does not authenticate, authorize or validate response contents.
